assert: (() => { const s = window.__homesim.getState(); return s.life.current.result.careRate === 0 && s.home.plants.every((p) => p.alive === false) && s.home.animals.every((a) => a.present === false); })()

(() => { const h = window.__life.view().home; return h.plants.length > 0 && h.plants.every((p) => p.object.userData.healthy === false) && h.animals.length > 0 && h.animals.every((a) => !a.object.visible); })()
